prompt_text: The maintenance record lists robot sensors, inspection dates and replacement parts.
primary: Mechanism implementation: group seven Q queries per KV head to share each global K/V tile load. Native already uses online-softmax and split-K. Attention is not established as the whole-model bottleneck.
operator_scope: B1/Hq14/Hkv2/Lq1/D64, FP16 finite values, unmasked, direct positive stride access to capacity-backed KV view. Native/native-compiled controls retain their own layout behavior. Fixed128-key partitions; no tuning.
reference: Independent float64 np.einsum optimize=False, stable max-subtracted softmax. Two input families at four lengths. Spare capacity filled with finite FP16 sentinel60000/-60000; check complete output and input immutability.
model_scope: Pinned original Qwen model and native generate_step; only instance-local decode Attention replacement. Unchanged native prefill, Q/K/V/O projections, RoPE, KV updates, sampling, prefetch. Two prompts and forced16 delivered tokens including EOS. No quality claim.
model_prefetch: Native generator prefetches one unreturned token: prompt+16 final KV offset;24*16 custom decode calls. Prefill calls24*ceil(prompt/2048). Throughput numerator only16 delivered tokens.
correctness: All operator and complete returned-logprob/token/final24-layerKV checks before any benchmark. Any failure saves details and stops all timing; no changed gates, shape substitution or tuning. Complete micro inputs/outputs and full model returned logprobs archived; final KV comparison in-memory with hashes, not public arrays.
timing: Operator normal family only:32 mx.async_eval calls followed by synchronization, elapsed/32; all outputs scheduled. Model:cache creation/native generator/generator close/adapter restoration/full stream synchronization included; model load, tokenization, result checks, audit copies and Cache object destruction excluded. Same prefetch work included. Amortized operator block time is not single-request p95.
order: Fixed seeded random order per round/repeat. Every trial retained. One primary GPU execution only after committed protocol/code and independent CPU review.
limits: No continuous batching, CUDA/Ascend, original Attention architecture, production or measured DRAM traffic. MLX allocator peak is not RSS. Peak/disk are checkpoint soft limits; separate parent kills worker after720s.
output: results/gqa-shared-decode-v1 (must not exist); partial progress and failure preserved
aggregation: Within each length/prompt and mode use the median of all recorded trials. Per-round comparisons use median within each round. Operator pass requires native/shared and native_compiled/shared >=1.05 at all four normal-family lengths, each with at least4/5 faster rounds. Model nonregression requires candidate/native total-request median <=1.05 at both prompts and candidate/native maximum per-request MLX peak <=1.05. Overall acceptance requires both. Whole-model speed claim separately requires native/candidate total-request median>=1.05 and >=4/5 faster rounds at both prompts. TTFT/TPOT descriptive only, no tail-latency claim.
memory: Before every model request, preserve prior global peak then reset MLX peak counter outside timer. Per-request peak includes common resident weights/operator fixtures and request allocations, excludes audit NumPy copies/RSS; record before Cache release. Compare max timed-request peak per arm, not correctness-phase allocations. Preserve global maximum across resets for8GiB checkpoint soft limit.
